# JJ

> JJ is a zero-dependency TypeScript library for imperative DOM manipulation. It wraps
> native DOM objects in fluent, typed classes and complements browser APIs instead of
> replacing them with a framework. No build step is required to consume the bundles.

## Start here

- [Skill guide (rules for writing JJ code)](./skills/SKILL.md): the canonical patterns,
  naming conventions, and pitfalls. Read this first.
- [API cheatsheet](./skills/references/api-cheatsheet.md): every public member with its
  exact signature, generated from the published type declarations.
- [`.ref` gap reference](./skills/references/ref-gap.md): the native APIs you are expected
  to reach through `.ref`, and the ones JJ already wraps.
